summary: Interpreted the completed receipt for the registered question and extended the account with an isolating successor experiment. The sampled operands confirmed the source prediction: re-synchronizing a replica that already accepted the configuration's StopSign (public reconnected() -> PrepareReq -> Prepare -> Promise -> AcceptSync) inflated its reported accepted index by one (accepted 7 over six indices of content on nodes 1 and 2, receipt 8b314551f1e049fcbf73a358f8ddf2c8 events 22 and 23), its read of the StopSign's own index 5 returned None, and its decided-log read from 0 collapsed to a single element (the StopSign), losing the five decided entries from the readable log; a write quorum of those inflated Accepted reports made the leader (event 24) decide index 7 while holding six indices, which flipped its own reconfiguration endpoint from true to false (is_reconfigured false, LogEntry::StopSign decided flag false) and made its decided log unreadable (read_decided_suffix(0) = None). The no-reconnect control in the same run stayed consistent (events 9-11), so the change is attributable to the re-established-connection path rather than to the reconfiguration or the sampling: comparisons 2-5 (leader endpoint, leader decided<=accepted, leader decided-log readable, follower decided-log content) were violated, comparisons 0-1 and 6-7 held. Updates: the interpretation is now violated/asserted with the full account, counterevidence and limitations; the index-accounting behavior is re-conditioned on the execution; a second behavior records the resulting index shift and decided-log read loss; the registered gap is answered with the traced legitimate producer path. Also submitted a successor experiment (previous_id given) that adds a single-follower-resynchronization case plus a read of index 6 with its baseline, to separate the follower-local inflation from the leader's quorum-based phantom decision and to show where the accounting places the StopSign. Incomplete: the successor execution, whether the snapshot-enabled create_log_sync branch inflates the same way, persistence and message-loss triggers, and the internal accepted-index vector behind the leader's phantom decision.
